sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: Their Mami (maternal aunt) and Mama (maternal uncle), along with other community members, are busy separating small stones and husk from the grains with their hands.

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: To keep them busy, Nani gives them a challenge of handpicking small stones from grains while keeping their eyes closed.

sections.heading: Learning Point 12
sections.content: The method of picking by hand from a mixture (when two or more substances are mixed) such as small stones and husk from wheat and rice is called handpicking.
sections.source_evidence: The method of picking by hand from a mixture (when two or more substances are mixed) such as small stones and husk from wheat and rice is called handpicking.

sections.heading: Learning Point 13
sections.content: It is done on the basis of differences in size, colour and shape of the particles.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14
sections.content: If the particles to be removed are present in small quantities and can easily be picked by hand, handpicking proves to be a convenient method.
